summary: Agi Inc, a Brazilian foreign private issuer whose NYSE-listed holding company owns Banco Agibank, filed a Form 6-K furnishing an exhibit announcing Rafael Siqueira as its new Chief Technology Officer, effective with the September 23, 2026 disclosure. Siqueira, a former McKinsey & Company Latin America technology partner and co-founder/CTO of three regional technology ventures, succeeds Vinicius Aloe, who led technology for over two years and will remain with the company supporting its strategic agenda. No deal terms, stakes, prices, premiums, advisors, board recommendations, or regulatory clocks were disclosed. This is a routine, planned executive appointment rather than a forced or abrupt senior departure, so no special-situation classification applies.
